pullRequests.head: level-18-d7310-size-exact
pullRequests.body:
Summary

func_L18_002D7310 (level 18, 484 bytes) goes from a size mismatch (488) to size-exact with 107 bytes off, so its fuzzy score in the report goes from 0 % to 77.9 %. It is staged in nonmatching/, not landed.
What got it there:

The post-call code is written in both branches, so gcc crossjumps the two calls into retail's single shared jal.
Prototype B for func_L00_0025F4A8 fixes the argument order. Exact callers in l13, l17 and shared already use it: 108 bytes off against 124 (A) and 137…

pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: level-18-veldin2
pullRequests.body:
Summary

After the recent merges, 13 staged level-18 candidates had dropped to a size mismatch and scored 0 %. Their best earlier attempts, read from build-sn/try/*/runs.log, still compile with the right size. I restaged them with nonmatching.py stage, which only replaces a candidate when the new one is closer.
Level 18's fuzzy figure goes from 26.06 % to 34.21 %; the overall figure from 22.36 % to 22.70 %. No function became exact, so the matched-function count stays at 2776 / 5109.
